wiki.title: Kathleen LaNatra
wiki.extract: Kathleen LaNatra is the 8th and current State Representative who represents the 12th Plymouth District in the Massachusetts House of Representatives. A member of the Democratic Party, she represents the towns of Halifax, Kingston, Pembroke, Plymouth, and Plympton. LaNatra serves on the House Committee on Technology and Intergovernmental Affairs, the Joint Committee on Economic Development and Emerging Technologies, the Joint Committee on Elder Affairs, and the Joint Committee on Election Laws.
